zoe: Quick note 1: running a short dry-run for admin-prune on billing-keyring tomorrow. Scope: identify stale IAM bindings, tag ownerless keys, and build an exceptions CSV. Goal: decision-ready list in 36h.

rahul: I'll take the last-used script for svcaccts and correlate with cron schedules. Will avoid pruning monthly jobs.

samir: I'll handle KMS IAM extraction and label reconciliation. Paste commands here so infra can eyeball.

rahul: last-used snippet (read-only):```bash
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svcacct-" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
Adds heuristic: log_count_90d and monthly_flag.

samir: KMS extract (read-only):```bash
gcloud kms keys list --keyring=payments-keyring --location=global --format="csv(name,labels)"
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format=json
```
I'll produce CSV: key,member,role,label_owner,createTime.

maya: Ops, please schedule a canary slot but don't run any unbinds yet. We need owner pings first.

ops-bot: Canary window placeholder created: 2024-09-01T03:00:00Z - 2024-09-01T04:00:00Z. Confirm when ready.

audit-bot: dry-scan queued: /scans/least_priv/3720004321. Expected run: 2024-09-01T03:10:00Z. Output: /shared/audit/least-priv/3720004321/report.json

zoe: Reminder: any cross-project grants must be labeled HIGH-RISK and require explicit owner ack before any change.

rahul: I'll post the annotated last-used CSV once the dry-scan completes. Will mark monthly/backfill jobs to avoid false positives.

samir: Thanks. After dry-run we'll send owner notices (48h TTL) and then schedule a controlled canary if owners OK. Keep rollback steps ready.

zoe: Also add a short exception template in the runbook: owner, justification, expiry (max 21d), and rollback commands. I'll triage exceptions.
